gloss: gift; treat; refreshments (for workers); care package

definitions.gloss: gift; treat; refreshments (for workers); care package
definitions.explanation: food, drinks, or small gifts brought to people who are working hard, such as coworkers staying late, performers, or students studying

examples.japanese: ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{差|さ}し{入|い}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
{差|さ}し{入|い}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: We shared the snacks that were brought for us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いった。
examples.english: I brought some treats for my colleagues who were working overtime.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ (to insert/give) + ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in) → something given/put in (for others)
- {差|さ}し{入|い}れる (to bring a gift/treat)
- {差|さ}し{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give a {差|さ}し{入|い}れ)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{差|さ}し{入|い}れ is a thoughtful gesture in Japanese culture, showing appreciation and support for people who are working hard. Common occasions include:
- Office overtime work
- School club activities
- Theater/concert backstage
- Moving day helpers
- Hospital visits

COMMON ITEMS:
- ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧ (snacks/sweets)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧ (drinks)
- ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ (rice balls)
- ⟦サンドイッチ→サンドイッチ：01366_sandoicchi⟧ (sandwiches)
- ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧ (coffee)

USAGE:
Also has a legal meaning of delivering items to people in custody/prison, but this usage is less common in everyday conversation.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{手土産|てみやげ}→手土産：08353_temiyage⟧ (gift when visiting)
- ⟦{陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い→陣中見舞い：18365_jinchuumimai⟧ (care package during busy times)
- ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ (get-well gift)
